findings.title: UX-00 Firefox MUST wording conflicted with later browser replaceability
findings.resolution: Requirement UX-M013 is converged to a dedicated managed worker environment. Firefox WorkspaceWorkers is the frozen v0 baseline; a custom shell may replace it only via the UX-12 promotion gates.

findings.title: UX-00 performance language still described budgets as pre-UX-09 provisional
findings.resolution: Requirements are converged to the frozen UX-09 budgets while retaining explicit empirical NOT_RUN status.

findings.title: Current task cannot authorize proposed implementation code paths
findings.blocker: Current allowed mutation scope is limited to task handoff, architecture/workspace-semantic-execution-*.md/json, benchmarks/workspace-semantic-execution/**, and tests/test_workspace_semantic_execution*.py; it does not include a new operator helper/extension code tree.
findings.smallest_next_action: Create or authorize an authority-owned implementation capsule/scope for the selected operator-bridge code paths. Do not self-widen this task.

findings.title: Firefox implementation/API smoke evidence not yet executed
findings.blocker: No built/signed extension/helper exists yet to prove target-host MV3, Native Messaging, sessions tab-value, tabs.onUpdated reduction, discard, profile launch, and native-host behavior.
findings.smallest_next_action: Implement UX-12 slices A-C and pass the fake-worker/target-host smoke suite.
findings.design_impact: NONE unless an API behaves contrary to the frozen contract.

findings.title: UX-08 implementation security checklist remains unexecuted
findings.blocker: Security design is reviewed, but the checklist must be applied to actual binaries/manifest/install state.
findings.smallest_next_action: Run every MUST checklist item against the built helper/extension before real-account testing.

findings.title: UX-09 empirical performance/resource evidence is NOT_RUN
findings.blocker: Frozen budgets have no target-machine helper/Firefox/real-ChatGPT measurement yet.
findings.smallest_next_action: Run simulator mechanical benchmarks after implementation, then target-machine real-account calibration only after the security/policy gate.

findings.title: UX-11 human-in-loop usability evidence is NOT_RUN
findings.blocker: The 5-action/20-action/recovery/hotkey trials are specified but not executed.
findings.smallest_next_action: Run the required human-in-loop simulator trials after the local bridge exists; zero hard failures are permitted.

findings.title: Fresh OpenAI policy/product review required before real-account test
findings.blocker: Provider rules can change; UX-08/UX-12 explicitly require a fresh review immediately before testing.
findings.smallest_next_action: Re-check current Terms/product guidance at the real-account boundary and stop if the product disallows the planned interaction.

findings.title: Normal ChatGPT authentication and profile behavior not yet validated
findings.blocker: Dedicated Firefox login/refresh behavior must be observed with the actual built adapter without scraping or auth automation.
findings.smallest_next_action: After security/policy smoke gates, perform the smallest manual-auth calibration and validate the UX-07 recovery signals.

findings.title: Production OperatorBridge transport is intentionally not selected by local UX design
findings.blocker: The helper must connect only through a transport already authorized by Workspace Control; UX-12 refuses to invent credentials/listeners.
findings.smallest_next_action: Bind OperatorBridgeClient to the implementation task's authorized control-plane transport.

findings.title: WebView2 authentication feasibility and material performance advantage unknown
findings.blocker: Embedded identity-provider flows may reject WebView2 and no measured advantage exists yet.
findings.smallest_next_action: Run fake-worker adapter parity first; only then run the bounded manual auth feasibility test if security review permits.

findings.title: Automatic updater
findings.disposition: v0 uses explicit reviewed update/rollback; do not add silent update authority.

findings.title: TypeScript extension toolchain
findings.disposition: Plain JavaScript remains smaller until adapter complexity justifies build tooling.

findings.title: Rust helper fallback
findings.disposition: Reopen only if measured .NET resource behavior fails UX-09 after bounded optimization.
